Marriott Bonvoy® World Elite Mastercard®

Card Benefits and Features

Earn up to 200,000 bonus points

  • Earn 100,000 Marriott Bonvoy points upon activation of your card and payment of the joining fees
  • Earn an additional 100,000 bonus points when you spend US$15,000 on retail purchases in the first three billing statements
  • Earn 6 points per US$1 spent at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy
  • Earn up to 3 points per US$1 on international and all other spends
  • Receive 15 Elite Night Credits towards your next Elite status level
  • Get automatic Gold Elite status, plus a pathway to Platinum Elite status on cumulative annual spend of US$100,000
  • Achieve Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status when you spend US$100,000 on the Card annually
  • Get 1 Free Night Award every year upon Card renewal (valued at up to 50,000 points)
  • Get 20% off at participating hotel spas in the UAE
  • Minimum salary required:  25,000
  • Annual fees:  1,575
  • Joining fees:  1,575

Where can Marriott Bonvoy points take me?

Redeem points for nights at over 30 hotel brands and 10,000 global destinations including:
The Ritz-Carlton Maldives, Fari Islands

The West Hollywood EDITION, Los Angeles

W Rome

JW Marriott Masai Mara Lodge

Santa Marina, a Luxury Collection Resort, Mykonos

Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa, Dubai

Mystique, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Santorini

The St. Regis Dubai, The Palm

The St. Regis Mumbai

W Dubai - The Palm

The above is an indication of where you can redeem your earned Marriott Bonvoy Points or Free Night Award, and these are subject to applicable terms and conditions of the hotels & resorts participating in Marriott Bonvoy and the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty programme.
